sections.title: Example 3.22 — distribution table, mean, variance and verification
sections.headingUrdu: مثال 3.22 — تقسیم کا جدول، اوسط، تغیر اور تصدیق
sections.headingPashto: بېلګه 3.22 — د وېش جدول، منځنی، واریانس او تایید
sections.theory:
\text{Mean}=E(X)=\sum_{x=0}^{4}x\,p(x)=\frac{840}{462}=1.8182

\text{Variance}=V(X)=E(X^2)-[E(X)]^2

=\sum_{x=0}^{4}x^2p(x)-(1.8182)^2

=\frac{1848}{462}-(1.8182)^2=4-3.3059=0.694

• Verification

Mean of hypergeometric distribution =E(X)=\frac{nk}{N}=\frac{5(4)}{11}=\frac{20}{11}=1.8182

Variance of hypergeometric distribution V(X)=\frac{nk}{N}\;\frac{N-k}{N}\;\frac{N-n}{N-1}

=1.8182\frac{(11-4)}{11}\left(\frac{11-5}{11-1}\right)

=0.694
